svg.title: Financial AI Assistant — four independent paths
svg.desc: Public Streamlit reads historical artifacts and session holdings. Offline research and APIs, experimental LINE integration, and private forward collection are separate paths. Current-market serving remains blocked.
svg.text: Separate runtimes — not every component runs inside the public demo
Visitor → historical OOF snapshots + permitted derived event metadata
Session-only demo holdings (0–5) · no database, provider request or runtime inference
02 RESEARCH / API · offline and versioned services
Historical data → temporal ML / NLP evaluation → frozen artifacts → FastAPI contracts
Ridge · HGB comparison · financial-domain BERT · explicit capability abstention
LINE → Cloudflare Edge → Demo GAS → FastAPI → PostgreSQL / Neon
Verified webhook / HMAC → user-isolated sandbox → GAS Flex reply → LINE
TWSE / TPEx → scheduled collection → immutable private R2 evidence
Future external validation only · no automatic retraining · no public request path
F11B-2A exact feature parity 5/23 · 6/9 gates · no live inference
